title: Nexus Networking Night 2027
resources: Sponsor-provided prizes, registration desk and photography team
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 66 attendees for this Networking Night, in line with turnout at our previous Networking Night events.
The requested budget of INR 24,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Networking Night.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
